headline: Kuwait Introduces New Regulations for Housing Finance and Loan Defaults
summary: Kuwait's Ministry of Finance confirmed Decree-Law No. 114/2026, introducing new rules governing real estate financing and loan defaults in the country.
why: Regulatory updates for real estate financing affect commercial bank lending standards, default provisioning, and mortgage market activity.

impacts.name: Kuwait
impacts.why: New financial decrees regulate domestic lending and real estate credit exposure.
